channel.title: Saturday Kitchen Live
channel.desc: Matt Tebbutt is joined by chefs Theo Randall and Ravneet Gill, and by special guests Alex Horne and Maisie Adam. Drinks expert Olly Smith pairs the wines to go with the studio dishes, and Carmen O'Neal is here to make some festive cocktails. There are also more great moments from the BBC food archive.
